source.rationale: The per-item note is appended when EITHER response field exists — the envelope is not guaranteed to carry both. With `response_intro` absent the note must still be appended to `response`; requiring both would silently drop the 'no promotion found for X' half of a partial answer.
source.repin_rationale: RE-PINNED for the team-name DISPLAY fix (captain 2026-08-24). Underscores now render as spaces at the interpolation. The ONLY difference in this expectation is 2 '_' becoming ' ' inside the team token of an escalate sentence - checked character by character (same length, same offsets, every flipped byte between "escalate to" and " team"); no other field, key or value moved. The raw slug is unchanged wherever it is routed on or persisted.
